newsitem.title: USA: DeKalb to market high oil corn seed.
newsitem.headline: DeKalb to market high oil corn seed.

text.p: DeKalb Genetics Corp said Wednesday it reached an agreement with DuPont Agricultural Products to market seed capable of producing DuPont Optimum HighOil Corn.

"DuPont's agreement with DeKalb, as well as several other seed company licensees, will substantially increase producer access to seed capable of producing Optimum High Oil Corn," Soren Raveling, sales specialist, DuPont Quality Grains, said in a statement.

Optimum High Oil Corn, which has an oil content as high as 8.5 percent, compared with four percent or less in typical varieties, was harvested from approximately 350,000 acres in 1996. Nearly one million acres are expected to be planted in 1997, Raveling said.
Optimum High Oil Corn is aimed at livestock feed markets.
DeKalb's announcement follows an agreement reached between DuPont and Pioneer Hi-Bred International Inc to expand a research agreement regarding high oil corn.
